content.name: Owen Barraclough
content.title: Sales Associate
content.summary: Sales associate with three years in independent retail in Sheffield, now on the shop floor of a running and outdoor sports store. Regularly hits weekly targets, runs gait analysis appointments and is trusted to cover till and stockroom on weekend shifts.

experience.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Serve 60 to 90 customers on a typical Saturday across running, football and outdoor departments, beating my weekly sales target in 41 of the last 52 weeks.
Run video gait analysis sessions after in-house training, booking about 25 a month and converting most into shoe and insole sales.
Signed up 380 customers to the store's running club newsletter, which now fills weekly group runs.
Receive deliveries and replenish the shop floor from the stockroom, flagging size gaps to the manager before weekend peaks.

experience.title: Saturday Sales Assistant
bullets: Handled till, card payments and special orders on busy Saturdays at an independent bookshop.
Built a staff-picks table for summer reading that sold out its first restock within a fortnight.
Gift-wrapped and packed web orders for collection, keeping the click-and-collect shelf tidy and labelled.

education.degree: GCSEs: 8 at grades 9–4, including English Language (6) and Maths (5)

courses.name: Emergency First Aid at Work (1 day)

achievements.title: Employee of the Month
achievements.detail: Named twice in 2024 for customer feedback and running club sign-ups.

achievements.title: Duke of Edinburgh's Award
achievements.detail: Completed the Silver Award, including a three-day expedition in the Peak District.
